answer_1.quote: ...dialogue summarization ... we collect fine-grained factual annotations for human reference and the output of 4 recent dialogue summarization systems ...

answer_2.quote: ...We include a list of popular evaluation methods for summarization... It contains three generic evaluation methods (ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore) and four dedicated faithfulness evaluation methods (FactCC v1, FactCC v2, FEQA, NLI) ...

answer_4.quote: ...At least two annotators are involved, and a verification process is incorporated to ensure the annotation quality... we have collected 750 fine-grained faithfulness annotations from 30 participants...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label whether a generated summary contains factual errors according to the defined taxonomy (SubObjE, ProE, NegE, ParE, HalE, OthE).
